description: Port of typescript-eslint's `prefer-function-type` (https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/prefer-function-type). Flags a type literal, or an interface with no supertype other than `Function`, whose only member is a call or construct signature with a return type; in such an interface the first `this` type (outside nested literals) is reported instead. Fixes cover call signatures without comments; the checks are split by fix shape.
